# Seng Soon Electrical Engineering Pte Ltd (成順電器工程私人有限公司)

> Licensed electrical contractor in Singapore, established in 1971 and incorporated in 1988. Family-run, with an in-house EMA Licensed Electrical Worker. Electrical installation, main switchboard replacement, lightning protection and earthing, maintenance, testing and commissioning, and EMA licensing.

## Key facts
- Established 1971 (sole proprietorship); incorporated 28 Dec 1988 as Seng Soon Electrical Engineering Pte Ltd (UEN 198804759R)
- BCA registered contractor, workhead ME05 Electrical Engineering, grade L1
- bizSAFE Star; ISO 9001:2015; ISO 45001:2018
- SMRT Trains registered contractor since 1998; lightning protection maintenance on the North-South & East-West Lines, Circle Line and Bukit Panjang LRT
- 200+ development projects since 1971; 300+ clients including small works and servicing
- Founded in 1971 by Teong Hien Sing, who still runs the company as Managing Director and Licensed Electrical Worker and oversees every job personally
- Takes on everything from repairs, servicing and licence renewals to multi-million-dollar installations; largest single contract S$6 million
- Every site led by its own supervisors, with more than a decade at the company (the longest-serving joined in 1992); in-house Licensed Electrical Worker sign-off; MCST servicing relationships of more than ten years

## Services
- Consultancy & design: Needs assessment, load calculations, equipment selection and electrical drawings.
- Supply & installation: Distribution boards, switchboards, lighting, power points, CCTV and EV chargers, for new builds and replacements.
- Fault finding & repair: Inspection and testing to find the fault, then repair or replace what's needed.
- Inspection & maintenance: Periodic inspections, preventive and corrective maintenance, earthing and lightning protection checks.
- EMA licensing: We act as your Licensed Electrical Worker for Electrical Installation Licence applications and annual renewals.
- Testing & commissioning: Pre-energisation testing, LEW technical advice, and liaison with SP Group for shutdowns and turn-on.

## Who we work for
- Main contractors and builders
- Electrical and M&E contractors
- MCSTs and building managers (direct contracts)
- Rail and transport (SMRT)
- Technology and systems partners (smart meters, parking systems, fire safety)
- Owners and businesses

## Frequently asked questions
**Can you renew our EMA electrical installation licence?**
Yes. Our in-house Licensed Electrical Worker can act as the LEW for your installation, handle the application or annual renewal, and carry out the required inspection and testing. Non-domestic installations above 45 kVA need this licence, and renewals should be filed at least a month before expiry.

**How often must our electrical installation be inspected?**
It depends on the premises. EMA requires condominiums and multi-tenanted buildings to be inspected at least once every six months, construction sites at least once a month, and most other licensed installations at least once a year. As your appointed LEW, we schedule and carry out these inspections for you.

**How long is the power off when you replace a main switchboard?**
Usually one night or one day, depending on the property. Residential shutdowns are scheduled on weekdays, and commercial buildings are usually done over a weekend. We can arrange a temporary generator if you need power kept on during the changeover.

**Do you handle breakdowns and emergency call-outs?**
Yes, for clients on a servicing contract, during office hours (Monday to Friday, 10am to 6pm).

**Can you install EV chargers in our condo?**
Yes. Once you have bought your chargers, we install them, from cabling to connection, and our in-house Licensed Electrical Worker tests and certifies the installation. We do not supply the chargers ourselves.

**Is Seng Soon a registered electrical contractor?**
Yes. We are registered with the Building and Construction Authority under workhead ME05 (Electrical Engineering) at grade L1, certified bizSAFE Star, ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018, and have been an SMRT registered contractor since 1998.

**Do you work directly with MCSTs?**
Yes. We contract directly with management corporations for switchboard upgrades and other common-area works, and we have held servicing contracts with some MCSTs for more than ten years.

**What size of project do you take on?**
We take on everything from repairs, servicing and licence renewals to multi-million-dollar installations, anywhere in Singapore. Our largest single contract was $6 million. Most of our new-build work is as the electrical subcontractor to a main contractor or M&E firm, and we partner with other contractors on the largest developments. Every site is led by one of our own supervisors.
